The tank is actually quite deliberate. Back in the 1990s, when they released the first G2 Transformers, it was impractical to reissue the original G1 Megatron, since he turned into a gun. This actually prevented the release of Masterpiece Megatron in the United States, which caused collectors to spend a good chunk of change importing them.

So for the G2 toyline, to make sure that there was a Megatron, they made a version that was instead a tank. It was a pretty good toy, the mold got used a few more times as I recall for different toys. Since then Megatron has tended far more often than not to be represented as a tank in most versions. I believe that's what his Combiner Wars self transforms into, and ultimately it seems more practical than having him transform into a gun. Shockwave works as a gun as an opponent, but still, a tank has a lot more mobility while keeping a lot of firepower, plus Shockwave never got downsized (since he was never reformatted on Earth).

The game itself, however, is pretty darn good overall. Be sure to read up a bit on crafting and what specific weapons do so you don't waste a lot of resources.
